bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0GM4YCY7B/?tag=offsitoftimfe-20), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8rzmyeryahQ), [Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/you-cannot-kill-david-arquette/umc.cmc.2bpxpw2zp5ttiw7l2xb9yp9l1)). This one is hard to categorize. I found it bizarre, hilarious, and uplifting. The trailer is worth 1,000 words, so click [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=84s&v=K5Ujq07y8Rk) for a brain tickle of WTFs. bullets.title: Jaspr Air Scrubber
bullets.note: I’ve tried a lot of air purifiers over the years, and there are a handful of great options. This is the best combination of function and aesthetics that I’ve found. I love the design and am buying more units for my family. It’s quiet enough to sleep next to, and it’s beautiful enough to put in your living room. Thank you to [Dr. Tommy Wood](https://tim.blog/2026/01/28/dr-tommy-wood-how-to-future-proof-your-brain-from-dementia/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) for introducing me to Jaspr. More from Dr. Wood coming soon to [the blog](https://tim.blog/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf).

bullets.title: About This Life: Journeys on the Threshold of Memory
bullets.creator: Barry Lopez
bullets.note: . I have fallen in love with Barry Lopez’s writing. If you’re new to his work, I would suggest reading [_Of Wolves and Men_](https://www.amazon.com/Wolves-Men-Barry-Holstun-Lopez/dp/0684163225/?tag=offsitoftimfe-20) or [_Arctic Dreams_](https://www.amazon.com/Arctic-Dreams-Barry-Lopez/dp/0375727485/?tag=offsitoftimfe-20) first, as they are nonfiction at its best. [_About This Life_](https://www.amazon.com/About-This-Life-Journeys-Threshold/dp/0679754474/?tag=offsitoftimfe-20) is a mostly autobiographical collection of essays. In descending order, my favorites are: “Learning to See,” “Orchids on the Volcanoes,” and “Apologia.”

bullets.title: Investigating Rapid-Acting TMS for Adolescent Depression
bullets.note:
Do you know a teenager (ages 13–20) experiencing symptoms of depression? If so, this may be worth a look. Dr. Sean O’Sullivan and his team at UT Austin are running a clinical trial using accelerated and personalized transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) to treat depression. It is drug-free, and the treatment is only five days long.  
​  
This is the very approach I’ve used personally, and I had my most recent TMS treatment for GAD/OCD last week. The results are some of the most impressive I’ve ever seen.  
​  
If you or someone you know might benefit, you can reach the study team directly: [texassaintstudy@gmail.com](mailto:texassaintstudy@gmail.com) or (512) 495-5995. Find their [ClinicalTrials.gov listing here (NCT06523439)](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06523439). Participants who attend all visits will receive a total of $525. The FDA cleared TMS for adolescent depression in 2024.  
​  
​_Disclaimer: To be an eligible participant for this study, you must have had fewer than 3 months of antidepressant medication treatment in the past year and fewer than 10 psychotherapy sessions in the past year._
